articles.summary: Zions Bancorporation (NASDAQ: ZION) today announced leadership changes in its technology and operations team, which are effective immediately: Jennifer Smith, who has served as Chief Technology and Operations Officer since 2015, will leave the bank following a 20-year career with Zions. Zions' Enterprise Technology and Operations ("ETO") will be led by a partnership of Margaret Mayer as Chief Information Officer and Ken Collins as Chief Transformation and Operations Officer.
